cookies_desc: At Gaswii, we prioritize your privacy and loading speed. We do not use invasive advertising trackers or sell your browsing history.
que_son_titulo: What are cookies and Local-First storage?
que_son_desc: Cookies and browser local storage (localStorage) are small technical data containers kept on your device so you stay signed in and your preferred dark/light theme is preserved across sessions.
nuestro_enfoque_desc: Unlike conventional commercial websites, Gaswii does not inject third-party ad pixels or trackers that monitor you across the internet. Operational state is processed securely directly on your own browser.
tabla_titulo: Technical Inventory of Storage Keys Used by Gaswii
clave_1_desc: Stores theme preference between dark mode (futuro) and light mode (luz).
clave_2_desc: Maintains active VIP Client or Staff session for instant 0ms ordering.
clave_3_desc: Caches frequent delivery addresses so you don't have to re-type them.
clave_4_desc: Cached gas cylinder catalog for lightning-fast catalog navigation.
clave_5_desc: Stores recent support ticket identifiers for quick status check.
duracion_permanente: Persistent (Until sign-out or browser cache clear)
como_controlar_titulo: How can you control or delete these items?
como_controlar_desc: You can clear local site data anytime through your browser's privacy settings (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox), or simply by clicking 'Sign Out' in your user profile.
